summary.text: Wallyn Kanoelani Christian is the Republican candidate for Hawaii State Senate District 13 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Tricia Mayumi Kwai Lin Nakamatsu.

paragraphs.text: Christian graduated from Leilehua High School and earned an associate degree in business management and a bachelor's degree in justice administration from Hawaii Pacific University, as well as two degrees in theology from Life Christian University.
